_comment: Shipped-feature tripwire. Each entry pins a live feature to a grep-able marker. tools/check_markers.js runs in presync + CI and FAILS if a marker regresses — catching one session's merge silently clobbering another session's shipped work. When you ship a feature that another session could plausibly overwrite (shared files!), ADD an entry. Never remove or weaken someone else's entry outside a PR that deliberately retires that feature. 'min' = minimum occurrences (default 1); 'forbidden': true asserts the pattern must be ABSENT (retired features).
